method: Independent visual review of 21 sequential samples per aspect (0.5-second spacing plus last frame), face and river contacts, native-resolution boundary and 3x falling-leaf comparisons. Static architecture tracked over all 240 frames per aspect, including four time bands and last-to-first seam. Complete decode and per-second pixel-motion checks. Browser UI and natural loops recorded separately.
finishing: New v9 generation registered to its own first frame; rigid architecture/deck background held fixed. Generated whole-trio region, river and boat, sky, foliage tips, falling leaves and lantern interiors remain moving. Soft 3.5px motion-region edges; falling-leaf envelopes preserve the whole original leaf including pale edges and motion blur. No individual face, head or boat overlay; no zoom/crop, reverse, retime or still-tail extension.

findings.mongle: No invented mouth in reviewed frames; original embroidered curved eyes retained
findings.marin: Single navy head, yellow felt appliques retained; no invented black pupils or eyelashes observed
findings.kkamong: Brown felt and green eyes retained, natural head/body reaction
findings.boat: One right-to-left passage; foreground vegetation occludes the boat in the correct order, with no boat-over-tree inversion in reviewed samples
findings.boundaries: No double head, visible rectangular seam or ghost at checked portrait boundaries; final landscape 6.5s leaf tip/outline/motion blur fully restored against the native generated frame
findings.stability: 15 of 15 fixed-background anchors pass the project target over all frames and at the loop seam; moving-object motion is assessed separately
findings.motion: Decoded motion remains in every second, including the final second; entire ten-second clip retained

rejectedCandidates.v6: Earlier approved visual samples missed high-frequency source jitter subsequently reported by the user; superseded
rejectedCandidates.v7: New generation rejected for source jitter and invented black facial features on Marin
rejectedCandidates.v8: Existing-video edit route returned provider content block and no output; stopped
rejectedCandidates.v9Native: Identity/occlusion accepted, raw background jitter persisted; only the finished output above is selected

limits: Numerical stability covers selected rigid points, not every animated pixel; visual samples do not prove every frame is defect-free
Moving felt textures, water and leaves differ at the loop join; this is not a mathematically seamless loop
Browser playback and UI acceptance are separate records; physical-phone performance and speaker quality are unverified
This is local web application and preview, not public or native-app deployment
